ns0:svg.ns0:title: VBPCA reconstruction from incomplete synthetic data
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: A synthetic two-pattern signal, noisy observed entries with unobserved cells in gray, and a VBPCA reconstruction. Held-out observations are excluded from fitting. This illustration does not establish rank selection or uncertainty calibration.
